correctness.rationale: Check graph convention first: G_{n,0}=K_{n+1}, apex at level0, top clique at level ell, edges between consecutive levels iff labels differ. For u_a/v_a with N(u_a)⊆N(v_a) and U={u_a} independent, the simultaneous replacement v_a→u_a sends faces to faces, is S_n-equivariant and is contiguous to identity via σ∪Fσ. Applying it to every third layer in G−w and G−N[w] yields blocks C_n=Ind K_n with Htilde_0=U_n, B_n=Ind(K_n×P2) with Htilde_1=U_n, and otherwise equivariantly contractible simplex blocks. Join Künneth and the apex cone Mayer–Vietoris give the unique homological degree and short exact rational S_n extension; Maschke splits it for ell=3k, and ell=0 is separately K_(n+1). The traces follow from χ_U(g)=fix(g)-1. Independently rebuilt 116 signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces for n=2,3,4 and ell through 6/4/2; each agrees with (-1)^degree times the character formula, including n=2, ell=0 and derangements. Finite tests corroborate the all-parameter equivariant proof.
